testcase.name: a custom window is honoured, so the rule is the timer's and not the caller's
a fresh timer holds nothing, so it cannot release something it never loaded
the countdown is what status reports and it never goes negative
a bound client never releases, however long it stays bound
five minutes is the phase's number
release happens at five minutes, not before
unbinding again restarts the countdown from the later unbind
a client that re-binds inside the window cancels the release
